proposal.reason: Primary change removes CollNet collective-network support end-to-end (plugin ABI/loading, proxy/network paths). Additional substantive changes remove CollNet topology graph construction/connection, reindex and rebalance algorithm selection/cost tables (Tree/Ring/FC/PAT), delete CollNet device-kernel specializations/function-table entries, and introduce a breaking external tuner ABI/config migration to v2 to keep algorithm-ID semantics correct.
